details:
Dear VRC Team,

I have an idea I believe you may be interested in.

As you know the VRC Team have been getting a lot of backlash on the recent Security update. For the main reason that many people rely on mods to be able to experience VRC. While the security update was only meant to discourage people from using mods with malicious intent. It also hurt more people that were not using mods for malicious intent.
   
This brings me to my main idea. What if the VRC Team, added mod support. 
This is how it would work. You would use the VRChat website as a hub for the mods. This way you have complete control over what mods are accepted and which are deemed malicious. This way you don't need to make as much new content, users can still get there 'quality of life' / 'accsecibilty' mods. This means less work for you, and more content for the users. Everyone accept for the cheaters are happy. This could also likely be intergrated directly into VRC as a new tab specifically for mods.

I do hope you reconsider the Security update in the future. I do really believe this is a good idea that could help out everyone. So please do consider it.

Best Regards,
Mytten
